claim_text: Standardizovaná architektura ESG reportingu zvyšuje strukturální podobnost dokumentů, ale sama neprokazuje stejnou hloubku manažerské integrace.
evidence_or_source: DiMaggio & Powell 1983; CEZ-001; MON-004; O2-003; SKO-001
limitation_or_counterevidence: Similarity may also reflect voluntary professional norms and group templates, not only regulation.

claim_text: Rozhodovací vazba na kapitál, riziko, produkt, dodavatele, odměnu nebo provoz je nejsilnějším zveřejněným znakem přechodu od formalizace k manažerské integraci.
limitation_or_counterevidence: A disclosed decision link does not prove adequacy, implementation in every decision, or final impact.

claim_text: Aktivita nebo output nesmí být vydávány za outcome či širší dopad.
evidence_or_source: Hsieh & Shannon 2005; O2-004; O2-005; MET-OUT/MET-RES/MET-IMP code definitions
limitation_or_counterevidence: The distinction remains interpretive when corporate definitions are ambiguous.

claim_text: CSRD a ESRS vyžadují zveřejnění governance, strategie, dopadů, rizik a příležitostí, politik, opatření, cílů a metrik na základě dvojí materiality.
limitation_or_counterevidence: This chapter describes the 2024 reporting frame, not a compliance opinion for any case.

claim_text: Taxonomy eligibility is distinct from taxonomy alignment, and taxonomy KPIs are not a whole-company ESG score.
limitation_or_counterevidence: Taxonomy metrics cover defined environmental activities and reporting boundaries.

claim_text: Limited assurance provides less certainty than reasonable assurance and does not automatically verify the effectiveness of strategy or real-world impact.
limitation_or_counterevidence: Exact assurance scope must be read from each assurance report.

claim_text: The final evidence ledger contains 45 key segments: 11 CEZ, 12 MONETA, 11 O2 and 11 SKODA.
limitation_or_counterevidence: These are analytically selected key segments, not every relevant sentence in the reports.

claim_text: Final distribution is E0=1, E1=8, E2=27, E3=8 and E4=1.
limitation_or_counterevidence: Counts are descriptive and are not used as a company ranking.

claim_text: CEZ connects its transition plan to the business and investment plan.
limitation_or_counterevidence: The link does not establish that every project will deliver the transition outcome.

claim_text: CEZ describes its 2025–2030 investment plan as focused on areas with expected 75% taxonomy alignment.
limitation_or_counterevidence: This is an expected future share, not realised aligned CapEx or impact.

claim_text: CEZ assigns board-level sustainability ownership and connects a common ESG task to annual variable remuneration assessment.
limitation_or_counterevidence: Exact remuneration weight and realised payout effect are not fully disclosed.

claim_text: CEZ discloses continuing lignite exposure, permanent biodiversity impact from mining and social risks of coal phase-out.
limitation_or_counterevidence: Magnitude and adequacy of mitigation are not independently evaluated.

claim_text: MONETA uses both mandatory annual-report disclosure and a separate reader-oriented sustainability report.
limitation_or_counterevidence: The separate report is selective and cannot substitute for the complete mandatory statement.

claim_text: MONETA's CEO-chaired Sustainability Committee meets quarterly, monitors targets and may initiate corrective action.
limitation_or_counterevidence: Minutes and concrete changed decisions are not public.

claim_text: MONETA links ESG-related KPIs to variable remuneration of responsible Board members and material risk takers.
limitation_or_counterevidence: The exact ESG portion of the qualitative component and actual payout effects are limited.

claim_text: MONETA reports reasonable assurance over a delimited financed-emissions calculation methodology.
limitation_or_counterevidence: Assurance supports the calculation, not portfolio decarbonisation or a causal impact claim.

claim_text: MONETA states that it lacks a measurable outcome target for financed emissions despite their materiality.
limitation_or_counterevidence: A work-in-progress statement does not show the future target's adequacy.

claim_text: MONETA reports a worsening adjusted gender pay gap and cancellation of a volunteering KPI.
limitation_or_counterevidence: Methodology and reasons for KPI cancellation are only partially visible.

claim_text: O2 combines GRI reporting with ESRS-oriented double materiality during a reporting transition.
limitation_or_counterevidence: The disclosed materiality process is less detailed than in CEZ and MONETA.

claim_text: O2 connects energy monitoring with server and data-centre upgrade decisions.
limitation_or_counterevidence: No project-level savings or investment value is disclosed.

claim_text: O2's supplier, training, digital-literacy and cyber-security counts are outputs rather than demonstrated behavioural or avoided-harm outcomes.
limitation_or_counterevidence: The programs may have outcomes not measured or disclosed in the selected segments.

claim_text: O2 restated historical carbon data and reported mixed trends, with Scope 1+2 increasing while Scope 3 decreased.
limitation_or_counterevidence: Boundary and methodology changes limit causal year-on-year interpretation.

claim_text: O2 reports board oversight and an ESG Committee but also states that ESG KPIs for evaluation of the highest governance body were absent in 2024.
limitation_or_counterevidence: The gap concerns the reporting period; later governance may differ.

claim_text: O2 explicitly states that the 2024 ESG report was not externally assured.
limitation_or_counterevidence: Absence of assurance does not imply false information.

claim_text: SKODA reports 18% taxonomy-aligned revenue, 71% aligned CapEx and 35% aligned OpEx and relates the assessment to company decisions.
locator: SKODA online Annual Report 2024, EU Taxonomy section
limitation_or_counterevidence: Taxonomy alignment is not a complete sustainability assessment.

claim_text: SKODA integrates sustainability into product life-cycle management, production controls and supplier targets.
locator: SKODA Annual Report 2024, Strategy and Environment sections
limitation_or_counterevidence: Detailed supplier-rating method and all site-level results are not visible in the selected online excerpts.

claim_text: SKODA discloses defined governance roles, an external expert council and recurring dialogue with KOVO trade unions.
locator: SKODA Annual Report 2024, Strategy and Social sections
limitation_or_counterevidence: No specific decision change resulting from these inputs is disclosed.

claim_text: SKODA reports a 39.9% reduction in water use per manufactured vehicle since 2010.
limitation_or_counterevidence: Intensity improvement does not establish the trend in absolute water use.

claim_text: Transparent disclosure of adverse trends, restatements, missing targets and negative impacts increases the report's decision usefulness.
evidence_or_source: Boiral 2013; Michelon et al. 2015; CEZ-005; MON-007; MON-011; O2-002; O2-007; O2-011; SKO-006
limitation_or_counterevidence: Negative disclosure does not itself prove better management or performance.

claim_text: A common mechanism-based comparison is more defensible than a single cross-sector ESG score.
evidence_or_source: Berg et al. 2022; Drempetic et al. 2020; cross-case matrix
limitation_or_counterevidence: The proposed mechanism scale is exploratory and not externally validated.

claim_text: Public ESG reports are valuable but limited evidence sources: they substantiate reported mechanisms more readily than causal real-world impacts.
evidence_or_source: all case memos; evidence matrix; methodological limitations
limitation_or_counterevidence: No operational, stakeholder or internal-document triangulation was conducted.
